svg.aria-label: Infographic comparing the prices Ollie and The Farmer's Dog publish on their own sites on 2026-09-26: Ollie lists Full Fresh Meals from 1.57 dollars a meal and the Half Fresh Plan from 1.00 dollar a meal, with its FAQ saying food starts under 4 dollars a day for small dogs fed Ollie exclusively and averages 8 dollars a day; The Farmer's Dog publishes one figure, plans start at about 2 dollars a day; the two use different units, per meal versus per day, so they cannot be subtracted

g.text: Ollie vs The Farmer's Dog: the price each brand actually publishes
Every figure below is printed on the brand's own site, read on 2026-09-26 (UTC+8). Left: per meal. Right: per day.
Ollie - priced per MEAL
From $1.57 a meal
Full Fresh Meals (premium), printed on the Meal Plans page
From $1.00 a meal
Half Fresh Plan (budget friendly), same page
Ollie's FAQ answers per day instead:
• starts at less than $4 a day for small dogs fed Ollie exclusively
• averages $8 a day
Source: ollie.com/meal-plans and ollie.com/faqs, checked 2026-09-26
The Farmer's Dog - priced per DAY
From about $2 a day
"Plans start at about $2/day" - the only price it prints
• exact plan depends on age, weight, activity and recipe
• delivery options mostly range from 1 week to 2 months of food
• those delivery options include free shipping
• no per-meal price is published anywhere on the FAQ
Source: thefarmersdog.com/faq, checked 2026-09-26
Different units: $1.57 a meal and $2 a day are not comparable, and neither is your final bill.
Both brands price your dog individually - Ollie in its plan builder, The Farmer's Dog through its questionnaire - so no official page publishes the same dog's price twice.
Read from the brands' own pages on 2026-09-26 (UTC+8): ollie.com/meal-plans, ollie.com/faqs, thefarmersdog.com/faq. Starting prices, not quotes.
No third-party comparison site was used, and no figure on this chart is an estimate.
